metadata.description: The pavé's beads on the shank (sharp: they are the pavé's own geometry). No pavé: a speck buried in the band.
Spun about its own axis, a quarter-turn onto +X, turned about the ring axis to its angle. An unused slot repeats the centre: the same head in the same place.
The heads melt into the shank (a smooth union). Every seat is cut AFTER it, the pavé's last.
The volume: ∫ 1 dV over the finished body (the notebook's Output; no density, no units).

The opening: offset in by the edge round, re-distance (a mesh round trip - Offset Body adds a constant to the field, so -e then +e would cancel), offset back out. Rounds every convex edge sharper than the radius and leaves the rest where it was.

The opened bars united as implicits (sharp). Bodies that cross each other come in separate bars: a mesh union's seams import as self-intersections. An unused slot repeats the smallest bar.
The bar (X radial, Y along the ring, Z axial) wrapped round the ring axis: one turn = Wrap Length.
